scope: Original common-person HD assets and existing Cao Pi cross-period reuse; lightweight checks; old battle untouched

artReview.method: All ten actual installed PNGs individually visually inspected with tools.view_image; all ten canonical native references also viewed directly; installed and reference bytes pinned again after viewing

assets.name: 魏延
assets.reviewMethod: Direct tools.view_image of actual installed PNG; native 24x24 reference also viewed directly with original detail
assets.notes: 红缨、头盔与胡须均完整可见，头部上方有连续背景；长脸、浓眉与暗红披巾可辨。原版头部轮廓为武盔类型。

assets.name: 姜维
assets.reviewMethod: Direct tools.view_image of actual installed PNG; native 24x24 reference also viewed directly with original detail
assets.notes: 布帽、冠饰、发丝完整，面容年轻、无浓密胡须，蓝灰披巾与其余人物有清楚区别；原版包头轮廓得到延续。

assets.name: 典韦
assets.reviewMethod: Direct tools.view_image of actual installed PNG; native 24x24 reference also viewed directly with original detail
assets.notes: 露额发髻、发冠与浓须完整，宽脸和灰黑披巾可辨；与P2包头巾版本有明确头部差异。

assets.name: 典韦
assets.reviewMethod: Direct tools.view_image of actual installed PNG; native 24x24 reference also viewed directly with original detail
assets.notes: 暗红包头巾及垂布、胡须完整，宽厚面容可见；与P1发髻版本分离。虽原图与许褚P1同字节，成品在面部、红褐布料及铠甲细节上可区分。

assets.name: 许褚
assets.reviewMethod: Direct tools.view_image of actual installed PNG; native 24x24 reference also viewed directly with original detail
assets.notes: 褐黑布帽、垂布与卷翘胡须完整，面容厚重；与P2带额饰发髻版本有明确差异，也未复用典韦P2成品。

assets.name: 许褚
assets.reviewMethod: Direct tools.view_image of actual installed PNG; native 24x24 reference also viewed directly with original detail
assets.notes: 额带/冠饰、顶髻和胡须完整，头部上方有连续背景；较宽取景保留上躯干，与P1包头布帽版可区分。

assets.name: 乐进
assets.reviewMethod: Direct tools.view_image of actual installed PNG; native 24x24 reference also viewed directly with original detail
assets.notes: 盔顶束饰、盔耳及胡须完整，较窄脸与深色盔甲可辨；盔顶靠近画面上沿但轮廓未被截断，不据此声称15%留白。

assets.name: 于禁
assets.reviewMethod: Direct tools.view_image of actual installed PNG; native 24x24 reference also viewed directly with original detail
assets.notes: 绿色长缨、盔顶、须发完整，头部上方有连续背景；绿披巾与较窄脸可辨，与P2露额发髻差异明确。

assets.name: 于禁
assets.reviewMethod: Direct tools.view_image of actual installed PNG; native 24x24 reference also viewed directly with original detail
assets.notes: 已为露额发髻与短须，未见错误头盔；髻顶、发丝和胡须完整，蓝披巾与P1绿色羽盔版可区分，也未共用典韦P1成品。

assets.name: 张昭
assets.reviewMethod: Direct tools.view_image of actual installed PNG; native 24x24 reference also viewed directly with original detail
assets.notes: 文士高帽、灰白头发与长须完整，年长文士面容及棕色衣袍清楚区别于武将；帽顶上方仍有背景，不据此声称15%留白。
